Running it
----------
simcity.d88 is a disk image for the NEC PC-8801 (V1 or V2: the game finds
out which at start-up).  Put it in drive 1 and reset the machine; it
boots straight into the game.

The game uses the 640 x 200 colour screen.  Cities are saved to and
loaded from the disk.

Keys
----
  Cursor keys     move the cursor one square (shifted: eight)
  O P Q A         left, right, up, down (shifted capitals: eight)
  Space, Enter    build with the tool
  , .             the previous and next tool
  0 - 9           choose a tool by its number
  H               pause or run
  + -             faster, slower
  M               the next mini map (X goes back to the city)
  B               the budget            V   the evaluation
  S               save the city         L   load a city
  X               the game menu: new city, options, disasters
